messages:
Support - Lina: Hey team, Enterprise customer StreamFrame reporting sudden 403s for production API calls starting ~11:07 UTC. Errors: \"403 Forbidden - insufficient_scope\" across multiple routes. They say token was previously valid. Escalating.
SRE - Marco: Got alert from auth-introspect alerting rule. Trend shows spike in 403s at 11:06-11:09 UTC. Any recent policy or auth-service changes?
Eng - Priya: We rolled out authz-policy v1.7.0 at 11:02 UTC which tightened scope evaluation and introduced scope-compact logic to deduplicate scopes in introspection responses.
Support - Lina: customer attached curl with token that used to work: 
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/123
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"error":"insufficient_scope","required":"streams.read"}
```
SRE - Marco: Looking at introspect service logs: tokens from 11:00-11:08 show introspect response scopes: "[ \"streams.read\" ]" for some pods and empty list for others. We have a split-brain between introspect cache and policy engine.
Eng - Priya: Reproducer: local introspect returns scopes empty when policy-engine returns compacted scope token with trailing comma bug. shipping bug: when deduped result length == 1 we accidentally returned an empty string in the JSON array. Opened MR with fix.
Security - Omar: Impacted: 7 enterprise customers; session tokens minted during 10:5811:10 UTC. Risk: tokens appear valid but lacking scopes -> unauthorized access. Could cause write APIs to reject requests causing customer app errors and billing reconciliation headaches.
Customer Success - Jenna: Notifying affected accounts now. Offering rollback window and assistance with token reissue.
SRE - Marco: Mitigation plan: 1) revert authz-policy v1.7.0 to v1.6.3 via canary rollback, 2) purge introspect cache entries for tokens minted in the window, 3) add temporary compatibility layer in API gateway to accept tokens if the original client_id matches a whitelist for emergency. Starting step 1 now.
Incidents Bot: Severity P1. PagerDuty notified.
Eng - Priya: Rollback started: targeting control-plane and policy engine pods. Canaries show success in us-east-1 after 30s.
SRE - Marco: After rollback, new introspect responses include proper scope arrays again. However some API gateways still reporting 403 due to cached introspection results in redis. Purging redis keyspace for introspect:keys for that time range.
Support - Lina: Customers report partial recovery but some mobile clients still 403ing. Possibly cached tokens on client or CDN edge.
Eng - Priya: We found that mobile SDK stored a cached introspect blob for 24h; pushing hotfix to SDK to invalidate on 403 responses is not feasible quickly. Instead, we will trigger a short TTL purge by sending a purge-notify to CDN + gateway to expire client side cached entries.
SRE - Marco: Executed redis purge + sent purge-notify to CDN. Monitoring logs.
Support - Lina: StreamFrame confirms recovery for web clients at 11:28 UTC; mobile app needs user to refresh token or app restart.
Security - Omar: Follow-ups: add stricter integration tests for scope-serialization, require unit coverage for compact logic, add canary gating (1% traffic) for policy changes. Also schedule key rotation verifications to include scope-preservation checks.
Eng - Priya: Patch merged for scope-compact bug; will deploy after tests pass. Also adding an atomic swap for policy config to avoid partial state application.
SRE - Marco: Post-incident action items: add metric for fraction of empty-scope tokens; alert when >0.1% over 5m, add rollout abort if policy-change touches scope serialization, improve redis purge tooling to accept time windows.
Customer Success - Jenna: Comms draft ready. Will include mitigation steps for mobile users: force re-auth via refresh-token endpoint and temporary client-side fix. Offering 1 day's service credit to affected customers.
Support - Lina: Repro steps for postmortem: 1) deploy v1.7.0 in staging with instrumentation, 2) run synthetic tokens through policy compact code path, 3) assert introspect output scopes non-empty for single-scope tokens, 4) simulate redis cache with mid-deploy eviction.
Eng - Priya: Timeline note: rollout at 11:02, first 403 at 11:06, rollback at 11:12, redis purge 11:20, all major customers recovered by 11:30. Will own the postmortem.
Incidents Bot: Postmortem assigned to Eng - Priya and SRE - Marco.
Support - Lina: Thanks everyone. Closing incident channel after postmortem publish. :white_check_mark:
